title: Prince Group chair Chen Zhi repatriated from Cambodia
detail: MPS said Chen Zhi, suspected of running illegal casinos, fraud and concealing criminal proceeds, was escorted from Phnom Penh to China; he is US/UK-sanctioned over alleged forced-labour scam compounds.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security via CGTN (state media)

title: MND calls Diaoyu patrols legitimate after record 356 days in 2025
detail: Defence ministry spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang called CCG patrols near Diaoyu Dao lawful and urged Japan to show restraint, after Japanese reports that Chinese ships were present on 356 days in 2025.
attribution: PRC Ministry of National Defense via Global Times (state media)

title: HK Customs steps up action on unlicensed money services on social media
detail: Customs said it detected 23 unlicensed money-service cases in 2025 (22 on social media), arresting 24, plus 4 account holders suspected of laundering; one holder was jailed 54 months.
agency: Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department
attribution: Customs and Excise Department

title: PLA monitors first US Taiwan Strait transit of 2026
detail: Eastern Theater Command spokesperson Senior Col Xu Chenghua said naval and air forces tracked USS John Finn and USNS Mary Sears through the strait and that the command remained on high alert.
attribution: PLA Eastern Theater Command via Global Times (state media)

title: China executes 11 Ming family crime group members
detail: State media said 11 people sentenced by a Wenzhou court in Sept 2025, including Ming family criminal group members, were executed after Supreme People's Court approval for homicide, fraud, unlawful detention and casino offences tied to Myanmar scam compounds; 14 Chinese citizens were killed by the group.
attribution: Chinese state media via Al Jazeera

title: Four Bai family gang leaders executed in Shenzhen
detail: Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court executed Bai Yingcang, Yang Liqiang, Hu Xiaojing and Chen Guangyi; boss Bai Suocheng died of illness. The group ran Kokang scam compounds involving over 29 billion yuan and trafficked about 11 t of methamphetamine.
attribution: Shenzhen court via Global Times (state media)

title: PBOC and seven agencies reaffirm crypto ban, bar offshore yuan stablecoins
detail: A joint notice declared virtual-currency business illegal, barred issuing RMB-pegged stablecoins abroad without approval, targeted disguised mining and restricted domestic RWA tokenisation.
attribution: People's Bank of China et al. via People's Daily

title: MPS: over 1,500 suspects repatriated from Myawaddy KK Park
detail: The Ministry of Public Security said 10 China-Myanmar-Thailand repatriation operations returned over 1,500 telecom-fraud suspects from Myawaddy, and more than 630 KK Park buildings were demolished.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security via Global Times (state media)

title: SPC: 41,000+ returnees from northern Myanmar sentenced
detail: The Supreme People's Court said over 41,000 people repatriated from northern Myanmar had been sentenced by end-2025, and 159,000+ telecom/online fraud cases (338,000+ defendants) were concluded nationwide 2021-2025; 16 Ming and Bai gang members were executed.
attribution: Supreme People's Court via People's Daily (state media)

title: Operation Wind Chain: Macau-mainland bust of casino exchange laundering network
detail: Macau Judiciary Police said 25 were arrested in Macau and 40 on the mainland over a network that laundered about RMB 45.6m of telecom-fraud proceeds through casino-side currency exchange and USDT; 11 underground banks in Zhuhai were dismantled and HK$5.7m cash seized.
agency: Macao Judiciary Police / Ministry of Public Security
attribution: Macao Judiciary Police press release

title: PLA tracks Japanese destroyer Ikazuchi through Taiwan Strait
detail: The PLA Eastern Theater Command said naval and air forces tracked JS Ikazuchi throughout its transit; the defence ministry called it a 'deliberate provocation' and lodged a protest with Japan.
attribution: PLA Eastern Theater Command via CGTN (state media)

title: Wei family Kokang syndicate goes on trial in Quanzhou
detail: Wei Huairen and syndicate members were tried on fraud, murder, extortion and organising illegal border crossings; prosecutors allege victims in China lost over 24 billion yuan and two Chinese citizens were killed.
attribution: Prosecutors via SCMP

title: Alleged Jinbei Group figure Liu Ren returned from Cambodia
detail: MPS escorted Liu Ren, whom Chinese authorities accuse of a central role in scam and online gambling operations of Chen Zhi's Jinbei Group, from Phnom Penh to China.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security claim via Cambodia Investment Review

title: HK police arrest 69 for laundering HK$200m of scam proceeds
detail: Hong Kong Police, with mainland authorities, arrested 69 people accused of laundering about HK$200 million from cross-border romance-investment scams via mule accounts; over 170 victims.
attribution: Hong Kong Police Force via SCMP

title: SPP: 1,200+ prosecuted for drug-related money laundering
detail: The Supreme People's Procuratorate said over 1,200 people were prosecuted for drug-related money laundering from Jan 2025 to May 2026, including a case laundering 48 million yuan via virtual currency.
attribution: Supreme People's Procuratorate via Xinhua (state media)

title: Shanghai court jails five over 200m-yuan crypto forex scheme
detail: Jing'an District court sentenced five people to 2.5-6 years for using cryptocurrency to move over 200 million yuan abroad illegally for clients; SAFE flagged the scheme from unusual transactions.
attribution: Shanghai prosecutors/court via The Block

title: NMC warns of record 41-44C heat in northwest China
detail: The National Meteorological Center forecast 41-44C in parts of Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia, with Turpan Basin at 46.2C, and 35-41C across Huanghuai and the Yangtze delta, lasting 6-9 days.
attribution: National Meteorological Center via China Daily (state media)

title: Storms, tornado and dam breach kill 15 in Hubei and Guangxi
detail: State media reported at least 15 dead and 9 missing after severe convective storms and tornadoes hit Hubei (Huanggang, Huangshi) and Typhoon Maysak rains flooded Guangxi; a reservoir dam breached and 275 were hurt in Huangzhou district.
attribution: CCTV/Xinhua figures via AFP/Euronews

title: China and Japan coast guards face off near Diaoyu/Senkaku
detail: China's coast guard said it warned and expelled the Japanese fishing boat Zuihou Maru from 'territorial waters'; Japan said it forced two Chinese ships out after they approached the boat.
attribution: China Coast Guard and Japan Coast Guard claims via The Defense Post

title: Typhoon Bavi lands at Yuhuan, Zhejiang after 1.7m evacuated
detail: Bavi made landfall late on Jul 11/12 near Yuhuan with sustained winds of about 144 km/h; over 1.7 million were evacuated in Zhejiang and ~34,000 in Shanghai, with flights, ferries and some high-speed rail suspended.
attribution: NMC and provincial authorities via AP

title: Red heat-health alerts for Hubei, Chongqing, Inner Mongolia
detail: The National Disease Control and Prevention Administration and CMA jointly issued heat health risk alerts, red for Hubei, Chongqing and Inner Mongolia; SW Chongqing forecast above 40C and Wuhan grid hit a record 18.11 GW peak.
agency: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration / CMA
attribution: NDCPA and CMA via China Daily (state media)

title: Landslide buries 10+ buildings in Pengshui, Chongqing
detail: About 18,000 cubic m of rock buried more than 10 buildings in Qingyang Village, Taiyuan Town; 8 confirmed dead and 34 missing, 10 rescued, about 1,100 residents evacuated; 30 million yuan allocated for relief.
attribution: Local authorities via The Watchers

title: CCG says it expelled two Philippine vessels at Scarborough Shoal
detail: China Coast Guard spokesman Jiang Lue said two Philippine government vessels ignored warnings and entered 'Chinese jurisdiction' near Huangyan Dao and were driven away, a day after Wang Yi warned Manila at ASEAN talks.
attribution: China Coast Guard claim via SCMP

title: CCG water cannon used on Philippine fisheries vessel at Scarborough
detail: Video carried by Reuters showed a Chinese coast guard ship firing water cannon at a Philippine fisheries vessel; China said it tracked and drove away two vessels that 'intruded'. Reuters could not independently verify the video.
attribution: China Coast Guard claim; video via Reuters

title: CCG 'rights-protection patrol' in Diaoyu Islands waters
detail: China Coast Guard said a formation led by the Hengsha conducted a patrol within the territorial waters of the Diaoyu Islands (Japan-administered Senkakus), which it called lawful.
attribution: China Coast Guard statement via China Daily (state media)

title: Typhoon Noul lands in Huidong, Guangdong; ~350,000 evacuated
detail: Noul, the strongest typhoon to hit China in 2026 so far, made landfall about 03:50 at Pinghai Town, Huidong County; CMA raised emergency response to Level II and 12 cities imposed 'five suspensions'.
attribution: CMA and Guangdong emergency management via CGTN (state media)

title: About 350 flights cancelled at Hong Kong airport for Typhoon Noul
detail: Al Jazeera reported about 350 flights cancelled at Hong Kong airport, a scaffold partly collapsed on a high-rise and at least 9 injured in Hong Kong; over 715,000 relocated in Guangdong.
attribution: Hong Kong authorities via Al Jazeera

title: 25th China-India Special Representatives talks agree new LAC hotlines
detail: Wang Yi and Ajit Doval met in Beijing; China's MFA listed eight outcomes including expert groups on early delimitation, two new senior-commander meeting points and two new military hotlines in the Eastern and Middle sectors.
srcname: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC
attribution: PRC MFA statement

title: Mudslide from Nepal side buries Gyirong border port
detail: A landslide originating on the Nepalese side triggered mudslides and flash flooding at Gyirong Port; officials initially reported 3 dead and 265 missing, with roads, power and communications cut and PLA, PAP and fire-rescue teams deployed.
attribution: Ministry of Emergency Management / local officials via Global Times (state media)

title: Gyirong mudslide toll rises to 7 dead, 554 missing
detail: Xinhua reported the Gyirong border-port mudslide toll at 7 dead and 554 missing as of Aug 29.
attribution: Xinhua (state media)

title: Landslide in Suichuan County, Jiangxi leaves 1 dead, 11 missing
detail: CGTN reported at least one person killed and 11 missing after a landslide in Suichuan County; two were rescued.
attribution: Local authorities via CGTN (state media)

title: CCG says it blocked Philippine resupply to Ren'ai Jiao
detail: Citing a source, Global Times said the CCG intercepted the vessel Lapu-Lapu and three military escorts about 60 nm from Second Thomas Shoal with tracking and verbal warnings after rejecting Manila's request; it said the ships withdrew.
attribution: Unnamed source via Global Times (state media); China Coast Guard account
